_comment: Unichain (130) currencies for SetOracleFeeds.s.sol. Parallel arrays; `symbol` keys into script/oracle_feeds.json, `decimals` is the token's own ERC-20 decimals (18 for native ETH = address(0)). Token addresses match script/price_pools/130.json. Unichain feeds are 18-decimal SVR aggregators — setFeed caches feedDecimals from the aggregator, so nothing extra is needed here. No WBTC/USD feed on this chain: the wrapped BTC token rides BTC/USD.
